messages:
Ivy: Quick thought  holiday drive-swap? Bring one wrapped, office-appropriate item, draw numbers and swap. Low-cost, low-drama. :gift:
Noah: Love it. Secret swap or open draw?
Bea: Number draw + reveal at lunchtime sounds fun. Can we also have a donate-instead option for folks who prefer that?
Ravi: Yes to donate option. Maybe a checkbox on the signup: swap / donate / opt-out.
Gwen: I'll whip up a quick Google Form. Remote folks can mail small items or choose donate.
HR Bot: FYI company gifting policy: keep items under $20, no gifting of alcohol in shared spaces, and avoid food with allergen risks.
Ivy: Good call. Let's set a $15 suggested max and note "no peanuts" on the form.
Theo: Also, can we add a GIF exchange? Post a holiday GIF when you reveal your gift. SFW only pls.
Bea: GIF + gift reveal = bonus points. Prize for best ridiculous combo?
Noah: Logistics  when are we doing this? Friday after standups or lunch? 12:30 works for me.
Gwen: Form options: in-person swap, ship it, donate instead, opt-out. I'll include shipping instructions for remote.
Ivy: Add a tiny "leave a joke or hint" field so recipients get a clue or a laugh.
Ravi: I'll handle printouts and number slips. Also can set up a small wrapping station if people want to re-wrap.
HR Bot: Draft event created: Friday 12:25-1:00. Please RSVP via the form by Thu 5pm.
Theo: Accessibility note: label items with small parts/choking hazards or strong scents.
Bea: I'll bring kraft paper, twine, and a couple of scissors for the wrapping station.
Noah: Sweet. Post sign-up link when it's ready! :point_down:
Gwen: https://forms.example.com/holiday-swap  pls fill by Thu 5pm. :tada:
Ivy: Thanks all  excited for tiny chaos, warm fuzzies, and charitable option. :heart:
